ViewProject patch: manual modal positioning — iOS doesn't layer

UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

patchViewProject

Installs the view-project Safari patch once the element registers: replaces _updateModalDOM with the lifted-dialog variant and wraps onDestroy so a modal lifted into document.body is reaped when the view unmounts (otherwise it orphans on top of the next page).
